name: Verified registry coverage
baseline_definition: Verified active in-scope facility sites / all expected in-scope sites
limitations: Site, owner category, region/zone; unknown expected coverage stated

name: Active affiliation
baseline_definition: Distinct sites with an effective active/conditional Directorate decision; report conditions separately
limitations: Ownership/facility type; licence and readiness not implied

name: Corrective completion
baseline_definition: Corrective actions independently accepted by due date / corrective actions due
limitations: Criteria version/severity; overdue still included

name: Renewal timeliness
baseline_definition: Renewals decided before prior expiry / recognitions due to expire in period
source: Prior decision expiry and renewal decision
limitations: Do not remove expired/nonresponding sites from denominator

name: Reporting completeness
baseline_definition: Verified complete or explicit nil returns / expected unit-period obligations
limitations: Partial/unknown/missing shown separately; period hierarchy fixed

name: Submission timeliness
baseline_definition: Expected returns received by adopted deadline / expected returns due
limitations: Late offline arrival remains late with outage context

name: Verification lag
baseline_definition: Elapsed central receipt to verification; median/p90 and outstanding ages
limitations: Open unverified returns reported alongside completed samples

name: Correction rate
baseline_definition: Verified returns requiring subsequent revision / verified returns in cohort
limitations: Cause and magnitude shown; higher reporting quality may initially increase detection

name: Source quality
baseline_definition: Values passing specified reviewed checks / eligible checked values; verification coverage separately
limitations: No unexplained composite trust score

name: Service contacts
baseline_definition: Distinct qualifying completed encounter IDs in period
source: Signed clinical encounter/disposition or verified return
limitations: Not unique people; remote/facility overlap reconciled

name: Distinct patients served
baseline_definition: Distinct reviewed patient links among qualifying encounters in defined cohort
limitations: Unresolved links and cross-country limits disclosed

name: Condition-coded encounters
baseline_definition: Qualifying encounters with specified condition/case-definition version
source: Source-coded diagnosis/assessment and approved inclusion rules
limitations: Separate confirmed/suspected; not population incidence

name: Institutional inpatient deaths
baseline_definition: Verified inpatient death dispositions by occurrence period
source: Signed source/death report under adopted definition
limitations: Community deaths, arrival-dead and unconfirmed reports separate

name: Institutional mortality proportion
baseline_definition: Eligible inpatient deaths / eligible discharges including deaths in same defined cohort
source: Stay dispositions and approved inclusion/exclusion definition
limitations: Case mix, transfer effects and incomplete records shown; not population mortality

name: Health-event review
baseline_definition: Time to acknowledgement/review and open urgent/unverified counts
source: Event/task state and actual owner receipts
limitations: Reports are signals until verified; no direct incidence denominator

name: Access fulfilment
baseline_definition: Eligible care requests receiving the suitable requested service / eligible requests
limitations: Withdrawn, unavailable and ineligible shown separately

name: Human acknowledgement
baseline_definition: Request accepted into covered team queue to actual clinician acknowledgement; median/p90/open overdue
limitations: Automated acknowledgement excluded

name: Unmet demand
baseline_definition: Distinct eligible requests unfulfilled because suitable capacity/capability unavailable
limitations: Deduplicate repeated attempts in an episode; show service/geography

name: Arrival-to-assessment
baseline_definition: Actual arrival to first appropriate clinical assessment; distribution and overdue
limitations: Stratify adopted urgency, service and incomplete timestamps

name: Continuity completion
baseline_definition: Required follow-up/result tasks accepted complete within adopted window / tasks due
source: Clinical task evidence and due time
limitations: Reminder delivery and patient nonresponse not automatically completion

name: Patient progress
baseline_definition: Programme-specific approved follow-up measure versus usable baseline
source: Versioned condition/programme measure and sourced observations
limitations: Missing follow-up, selection and self-report attribution visible

name: Clinical workload
baseline_definition: Attributable clinical task minutes / available approved staffed minutes
limitations: Includes prep/documentation/results/handover; preserve breaks and urgent reserve

name: Service coverage
baseline_definition: Required service windows actually covered by privileged team / planned approved windows
limitations: No inference from account count or optional HR employment list

name: Readiness freshness
baseline_definition: Active service capabilities with valid readiness / capabilities expected to operate
limitations: Readiness is not accepted referral or guaranteed future availability

name: Referral acceptance
baseline_definition: Requests with actual receiving acceptance / eligible requests
limitations: Declines/unreachable/pending separated; window and cohort explicit

name: Referral completion
baseline_definition: Referrals with verified receiving outcome / referrals due for outcome
source: Accepted handover, receipt and outcome evidence
limitations: Acceptance and travel alone not completion

name: Geographic service reach
baseline_definition: Demand areas meeting adopted serviceability definition / required demand areas
source: Civil geography, actual capabilities and travel/access model
limitations: Facility count alone insufficient; estimation assumptions visible

name: Diagnostic turnaround
baseline_definition: Order/collection/receipt/release stage durations by service
limitations: Outside-reference labs and rejected specimens separated

name: Critical result follow-through
baseline_definition: Critical results with actual acknowledgement/action under policy / critical results requiring review
source: Approved critical flag and clinical task evidence
limitations: Delivery receipt is not clinical acknowledgement

name: Medication reconciliation
baseline_definition: Eligible transitions with completed reviewed reconciliation / transitions requiring it
limitations: Actual review evidence, not empty checkbox; missing data explicit

name: Medication omissions
baseline_definition: Actual not-given/held/refused events by eligible administration opportunities
limitations: Clinical appropriateness reviewed; omissions not all errors

name: Clinical stockouts
baseline_definition: Service/product periods with unavailable essential local stock under defined catalogue
source: Stock movements, physical verification and demand
limitations: Uncertain stock and quarantine separate; actual required products defined locally

name: Occupancy
baseline_definition: Occupied qualified bed-time / available staffed qualified bed-time
source: Actual local occupancy and service capacity
limitations: Closed/unqualified beds excluded with reason; reservations separate

name: Length of stay
baseline_definition: Actual admission to discharge duration distribution for eligible stays
limitations: Open stays, transfers, service/case mix and incomplete timestamps visible

name: Education delivery
baseline_definition: Delivered/engaged/reviewed-understanding measures separately by approved programme
source: Content version and actual channel/feedback evidence
limitations: Delivery is not comprehension or health improvement

name: Intervention fulfilment
baseline_definition: Accepted-evidence completed interventions / interventions due; outcome review separately
source: Owner acceptance, due, evidence and reviewer events
limitations: Unfunded/unaccepted/blocked included as exceptions

name: Sponsored care delivery
baseline_definition: Distinct eligible beneficiaries with qualifying delivered services; fund use and continuity separately
source: Programme eligibility, fulfilment and reviewed patient links
limitations: No raw clinical sponsor disclosure or double-counted included care

name: Care contribution
baseline_definition: Approved recognised care revenue minus attributable variable costs
limitations: Restricted funds/receipt not automatically revenue; no double-counted provider cost

name: Reconciliation exceptions
baseline_definition: Unmatched/unbalanced service, receipt, claim or posting items by age/value
limitations: Per-currency; estimates separated from confirmed amounts

name: AI usefulness
baseline_definition: Time saved and correction burden versus baseline, critical errors and cost per useful task
source: Governed evaluation and reviewed workflow samples
limitations: Fluency/usage not safety or efficacy

name: Experience burden
baseline_definition: Unassisted task success, repeat-entry count, abandonment and reported attentiveness
limitations: Segment patient/caregiver/clinical/institutional roles and accessibility needs

name: Local continuity
baseline_definition: Completed enabled clinical journeys during qualified WAN outage / tested enabled journeys
source: Offline scenario evidence and transaction counts
limitations: Qualification result, not proof of universal uptime

name: Sync health
baseline_definition: Oldest unacknowledged event age; accepted/duplicate/conflict/quarantine counts
limitations: Central receipt differs from semantic acceptance; local care not labelled failed by WAN alone

name: Disclosure safety
baseline_definition: Detected unauthorised access/disclosure and control test outcomes
limitations: Absence of reports not proof of anonymity or security

name: Country/service readiness
baseline_definition: Scoped activations with complete adopted evidence / proposed activations
limitations: Architecture/global accounts do not imply clinical coverage
